entities.summary: Eynhallow is a small, presently uninhabited island in Eynhallow Sound, between Rousay and the Mainland of Orkney, off the north coast of mainland Scotland. It is 75 hectares in area. There is an unnamed skerry about 100 metres to the north-east of the island, separated by Fint Sound. Sheep Skerry adjoins the southern end of the island.
